title: GTFS multi-feed license catalog + scaling
context: Scaling transit-access explainers to multiple metros requires knowing which GTFS feeds permit derivatives. There is no blanket GTFS license; each transit agency has its own terms. Repeating full individual license research for every new metro is expensive. A multi-feed license catalog systematically triages feeds so contributors can quickly identify viable metros and reuse prior research — while maintaining the gate-003 standard.
objective: Research and catalog the license terms of at least 10 GTFS agency feeds, triaging each as PASS/FLAG/EXCLUDE for use in transit-access explainers, and provide a reusable scaling pattern for future metros.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 10 GTFS agency feeds researched and triaged: license id + URL + permitted-derivative determination (PASS/FLAG/EXCLUDE) + required attribution string recorded for each.
Per-feed triage follows gate-003 criteria: restrictive/no-derivative/unclear feeds marked EXCLUDE; share-alike feeds noted with output license implications; clear PD/CC-BY feeds marked PASS.
Catalog committed as a reviewable, reusable document (e.g. gtfs-license-catalog.md or structured JSON).
License reviewer sign-off on the catalog approach and at least one sample triage decision.
Catalog provides a documented scaling pattern for adding more metro feeds to future transit explainers.
resources: PLAN.md — Data, licensing & compliance (GTFS feeds row)
output: A committed GTFS multi-feed license catalog (gtfs-license-catalog.md or JSON) with at least 10 agency feeds triaged and a documented scaling pattern for future metro transit explainers.
